name: Levels for the letters the uploaded curriculum does not reach
WHY_THIS_FILE_EXISTS: levels.json covers 31 base letters. Nine have no level in it: ঈ ঊ ঋ ঐ ঔ ঠ ঢ য ষ.
Four of those - ঠ ঢ য ষ - did have one in the 34 letter-per-level game this replaced,
so leaving them out is a regression in what the alphabet run actually teaches.
These levels fill five of the nine, built from words in tools/vocabulary.py that the
uploaded curriculum does not use. Same rules: every word starts with the level's akshara
(type=akshara) or its letter (type=letter), 3 or more words, a wheel of at most 8 tiles,
and a board inside 5 rows by 6 columns.
Kept separate from levels.json so the uploaded file stays exactly as it arrived and it is
always clear which levels came from where. catalogue.py reads both and orders them together.
ঈ ঊ ঐ ঔ still have no level and cannot get one under these rules. The whole of
word-initial ঈ is ঈগল and ঈদ; of ঊ, ঊনিশ and ঊষা; ঐ has only ঐক্য and ঔ only ঔষধ. A level
needs three words, and no word that starts with another letter may go on the board - which
is exactly how the old game filled these levels, with bridging words, and exactly what the
akshara-keyed rule forbids. They need three real words each, or nothing.
FLAG_NOTES: The uploaded curriculum's test is that a picture could replace the gloss. Some words here
do not pass it, and are flagged rather than quietly included: they are the only way their
letter gets a level at all. ঠ has five word-initial words in the pool and ষ has three, so
there is no concrete alternative to choose instead.
